title: Repository Taxonomy Rules
description: Machine-readable encoding of the Evolith Repository Taxonomy. Naming, structure, and artifact classification rules for all Evolith repositories.

rules.title: File names use kebab-case
rules.description: All file names use kebab-case (lowercase with hyphens). No spaces, no underscores in file names. Example: my-file-name.md, user-service.ts.
rules.validationQuery: File names validated via linting or CI script. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z]+$

rules.title: Class and type names use PascalCase
rules.description: Classes, interfaces, types, enums, and UI components use PascalCase.
rules.rationale: ADR-0056: Ubiquitous language enforcement. PascalCase for types/components.
rules.validationQuery: ESLint naming-convention for classes and interfaces.

rules.title: Variable and function names use camelCase
rules.rationale: ADR-0056: camelCase for variables and functions.
rules.validationQuery: ESLint naming-convention for variables and functions.

rules.title: Constants use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE
rules.description: Compile-time constants and configuration keys use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.

rules.title: Evolith Core structure: reference/, sdk/, rulesets/
rules.description: Evolith Core repository uses three primary directories: reference/ (human-authored standards), sdk/ (CLI tooling), rulesets/ (machine-readable rules). No other top-level content directories.
rules.rationale: Repository Taxonomy defines three entry points with clear ownership.
rules.validationQuery: Top-level directories match taxonomy. No arbitrary content directories added.

rules.title: Satellite structure: src/, tests/, docs/
rules.description: Satellite repositories follow standard structure: src/ (source code), tests/ (test code), docs/ (documentation). Infrastructure code lives under src/Infrastructure, domain code under src/Domain.
rules.validationQuery: Satellite root has src/, tests/, docs/ directories. Hexagonal layers under src/.

rules.title: ADR files named with zero-padded ID
rules.description: ADR files use format: NNNN-descriptive-name.md where NNNN is zero-padded 4-digit number. Example: 0002-clean-architecture-nestjs.md, 0069-dotnet-grpc-service.md.
rules.rationale: ADR-0048: Canonical numbering enables sorting and referencing.

rules.title: Bilingual ADR files use .es.md suffix
rules.description: Spanish translations of ADRs use .es.md suffix in same directory. Example: 0002-clean-architecture-nestjs.es.md alongside 0002-clean-architecture-nestjs.md.
rules.rationale: Bilingual naming convention: Pattern A for individual files.
rules.validationQuery: Bilingual parity: every .md ADR has corresponding .es.md in same directory.

rules.title: Evolith reference artifacts in reference/
rules.description: Reusable policy, decision criteria, and accepted trade-offs go in reference/architecture/, reference/governance/, reference/knowledge/. These are normative or decisional depending on document status.
rules.rationale: Repository Taxonomy: Canonical Reference goes in reference/.
rules.validationQuery: Architecture decisions, standards, and patterns placed in correct reference/ subdirectory.

rules.title: Product-specific evidence not in reference/
rules.description: Product-specific routes, schemas, seeds, and branding do NOT go in reference/. They go in the satellite repository. Enterprise policy changes go through Evolith governance.
rules.rationale: Repository Taxonomy: Product evidence stays in product repo, not reference.
rules.validationQuery: No product-specific files in reference/. Product evidence in satellite repositories.

exitCriteria.description: All files follow naming conventions. Directory structure matches taxonomy. ADR files correctly numbered.
